title: A session waiting on CI never sleeps through the result
why: Your gripe, Oct 26 ("how come I haven't seen much done in the past hours?"): nothing moved for about 2.5 hours. Batch #649's gates-macos job went red at 22:05 and green at 22:09; a run with a failed job sends no all-done event, a green job wakes nobody, and the build advisor had set no check-in, so it never woke.
note: Done: PR 651 merged Oct 27. gates.yml's last job, ci-done, posts one PR comment when a run ends with a failed or cancelled job (shared action actions/ci-done-comment). Measured on batch 663: the bot comment woke the watching build advisor as issue_comment.created about 2 minutes after the post. A run cancelled by a newer push posts nothing. Fallback rule git-ci-wait-checks-in: a send_later check-in on each CI wait and after each red job. Stall check for standing roles in the project-ops operating model. Platform ask for shiv: plans/c88-platform-ask.md in project files. Port: yes; the rule is global and the comment action is opt-in for each repo.
